summary: Orangekloud Technology Inc., a Cayman exempted company, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an Exchange Agreement dated August 21, 2026, to acquire Orbis Technology Limited, a New Zealand company. The transaction exchanges up to 3,967,705 Orbis shares for up to 600,000,000 Orangekloud ordinary shares (pre-reverse-split), with each Orbis share exchanged for 37.8048 Class A and 113.4144 Class B shares, implying a deemed value of $1.00 per share. Over 75% of Orbis shareholders signed, expected to rise to at least 93% via drag-along rights. Orbis will provide a $1,000,000 non-refundable deposit. Closing occurs remotely after conditions are met; warrants may convert or remain. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder approvals.
